findings.finding: Single-linkage grouping joins any neighboring parameters whose gap <= tolerance, but flags unresolved only when the full cluster span <= tolerance. A same-solid same-face chain can span > tolerance, avoid all ambiguity reasons, and be replaced by one mean event; short VOID intervals then vanish before occupancy classification, allowing IN_MATERIAL when the remaining interval midpoints are inside.
findings.counterexample: tol=1; same-face hit parameters [10.0,10.9,11.8,12.7] form one cluster with span=2.7 and no reason. Alternating occupancy has 0.9-wide void intervals that should be UNKNOWN under the interval width rule, but the mean event at 11.35 erases them.
findings.recommendation: Fail UNKNOWN for any cluster containing distinct parameters, or preserve individual events and prove every induced interval; retain raw hits. Add the pure-math chain regression before CAD execution.

findings.finding: The module returns per-pair eligibility and explicitly marks whole_asset_physics_status=NOT_ASSESSED. No backend/assets/native path calls the classifier. There is no rule to reject the whole asset when UNKNOWN affects a declared critical region, nor proof that graph counts, IDs, corrections, kernels, and storage are built only after filtering.
findings.recommendation: Keep this module isolated. Before any real asset admission, implement and validate the asset-level UNKNOWN gate and pre-initialization native graph ordering, with post-filter degree/correction/storage assertions.

findings.finding: A nonnegative source accuracy and nonempty basis string are accepted without checking against actual STEP or OCC vertex/edge/face tolerances, coordinate scale, or candidate asset provenance. A digest is computed from actual bytes and compared correctly, but the expected digest is caller supplied and no trusted source manifest or candidate-to-STEP hash binding is included; a digest of the wrong STEP still matches. Hashing and CadQuery path import are separate reads, leaving a file-replacement TOCTOU window.
findings.recommendation: Bind candidates and canonical STEP through trusted asset metadata; incorporate measured OCC/STEP tolerance into the conservative uncertainty bound; import from the same immutable byte snapshot that was hashed.

findings.finding: Finite accuracy+tolerance can overflow to infinity; the resulting interval path should become UNKNOWN, but an infinite tolerance is still passed to OCC endpoint classification. Squared-distance fsum and positive hit-parameter fsum may overflow and escape as exceptions instead of producing a structured UNKNOWN record.
findings.recommendation: Check the combined band is finite before any OCC call; use math.hypot and a stable cluster midpoint; map arithmetic exceptions to UNKNOWN.

findings.finding: No source-level counterexample was established for OCC returning incomplete intersections. However, when IsDone=True and NbPnt=0, the segment is represented by one midpoint-only interval; endpoint IN plus midpoint IN can yield IN_MATERIAL. Tangency/overlap safety therefore relies on OCC reporting those events. The current sphere tangent test has endpoints outside the solid and has not been executed; there are no coincident/shared-edge/vertex controls.
findings.recommendation: In the minimal CAD pass, verify all-hit results and UNKNOWN behavior for tangent, coincident, and shared-edge/vertex paths, including a tangent path with endpoints inside material. Preserve incomplete/ambiguous results as UNKNOWN.

findings.finding: Tests are code-only and unrun. The planned solid-coupon negative control (geometry-blocked=0 and entire filtered pair set equal to the baseline graph) is not implemented; current coupon assertion checks only one pair. The SHA test checks a deliberately wrong expected hash against invalid bytes, but no valid STEP match/import or asset admission gate is exercised.
findings.recommendation: First execute hollow-shell and solid-coupon tests after the pure-math regression is fixed. Treat this only as a check of the isolated classifier; it does not approve a real vessel or native integration.

api_review.cadquery: Installed CadQuery 2.8.0 source importStep(fileName, unit="MM") sets xstep.cascade.unit and documents OCCT scaling from the STEP-declared unit to the target. The mm-to-m and parameter-unit chain is consistent by source inspection.
api_review.ocp: Installed metadata is cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1; class bindings are binary-only in the package. The call shape is consistent with repository usage and OCCT IntCurvesFace_ShapeIntersector documentation, but runtime behavior under this exact build was not executed.
api_review.side_effect: CadQuery sets the process-global Interface_Static xstep.cascade.unit; concurrent imports should be serialized or guarded.

next_test_assessment.pure_math_regression: Necessary and sufficient to expose the identified cluster-chain defect, not sufficient to validate OCC.
next_test_assessment.minimal_cad_gate: After fix, hollow shell plus solid coupon is the smallest useful executable gate: assert the four shell crossings, IN/OUT/IN intervals, AIR_PATH exclusion, eligible coupon pair, zero coupon geometry exclusions, and reciprocal output.
